messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-proxy-prod" alert="p90_latency" pd_incident=PDI-1432
incident-bot: automated note: threshold crossed (p90 > 300ms) in us-west-2 for 3m, auto-page route=oncall-engineering
sam: acked (I'm on it) :hand:
maria: thanks — do we have customer requests in that region right now?
sam: checking request logs + grafana. grabbing tail of router logs now
leo: +1 on logs, I can pull the proxy histogram. also tagging @dave in case it escalates
sam: quick look — traffic looks normal, small spike of ~12% request size at 11:02. KV cache warmups visible in traces. link: https://grafana.example/redwood/proxy?orgId=1&from=now-10m
dave: seeing a flurry of short-lived retries from the streaming clients, maybe a bad batch sequence from one customer sdk version
maria: any customer-facing errors or 5xxs?
sam: 5xxs are flat, latency only. no error budget burn on prod metrics.
ops-bot: note: PD reminder sent to oncall rotation, auto-escalation in 8m if unacked by another.
incident-bot: pager resolved automatically (condition cleared) — duration 4m, reason: p90 back under threshold
leo: it resolved quick. could be transient kv prefill / cache TTL interplay. i saw a KV prefill spike at 11:04 in traces.
dave: if it's kv-warmup related we should add a short backoff on prefill churn, or bump the prefill concurrency. filing a follow-up ticket: https://jira.example/browse/OPS-9334
maria: agree — but let's not touch prefill in prod without canary. can we suppress repeat alert noise? maybe add an adaptive cooldown to rule p90_latency
sam: propose: add 1) 3m cooldown after auto-resolve before re-alert, 2) tag alerts that are kv-prefill correlated to route to infra team only
leo: LGTM. also add a tiny metric on prefill concurrency to make root-cause easier next time
ops-bot: silenced duplicate alert for 10m on channel eng-oncall (manual by sam) :mute:
sam: handoff note for next oncall: brief transient p90 spike, likely kv warmup from client retry batch. no customer-facing errors observed. follow-up ticket OPS-9334.
maria: thanks — leaving a quick runbook step: if this recurs >3x/day, escalate to infra and consider raising cache TTL.
dave: pinging infra slack group for visibility: @infra-team
infra-team: got it, we'll look at prefill tracing and canary a parameter change tomorrow
sam: closing thread — monitor for recurrence. :white_check_mark:
